content:
Melania Trump on Thursday urged Democrats to focus on helping to run the country rather than investigating her family.

Speaking on the red carpet at the premiere of her new two-part docuseries, “Melania: The Series,” at New York’s Lincoln Center, the first lady was asked whether she was concerned about potential investigations into the Trump family’s business dealings and finances following Democrats’ takeover of the House and Senate in the 2026 midterms.

She replied: “Well, we went through a lot already and we are used to it and I just suggest that they focus on a positive stuff and take time to take care of United States and not spend time into investigations.”

The first lady was less forthcoming when asked earlier to reveal her husband Donald Trump’s worst habit.

“Come on, give me one,” the reporter pressed.

“Trust, and, trust in family,” she replied.

Its two episodes are titled “Family & Trust” and “Pride & Honor.”
